extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral scientists seeking transition to tenure-track faculty positions (potential applicants to the HHMI Hanna H. Gray Fellows / Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and selection criteria for the HHMI Hanna H. Gray Fellows Program, a fellowship that supports postdoctoral scientists transitioning to independent, tenure-track faculty roles and that now integrates with the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program for extended faculty support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptional promise as future leaders in academic science
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hanna H. Gray Fellows Program is a transformational award for postdoctoral scientists who show exceptional promise as future leaders in academic science, advancing foundational discoveries while fostering inclusive scientific cultures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should demonstrate potential for leadership in academic research, ability to advance foundational discoveries, and a commitment to fostering inclusive scientific cultures. Fellows join HHMI's multigenerational community where they learn from experts and peers as they build creative and effective research environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — career stage and institutional requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Postdoctoral scientists ready to start their independent research program; must be from an eligible institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be postdoctoral researchers prepared to launch an independent research program and must be affiliated with an institution that appears on the program's list of eligible institutions (see 'Eligible Institutions' resource link).

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing / proximity to pursuing independent faculty position
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2026, postdoctoral scientists within two years of pursuing an independent, tenure-track faculty position will apply to be Hanna Gray Fellows as part of the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program specifies a time window relative to when candidates are seeking independent, tenure-track roles; prospective applicants should verify the applicable window for each competition cycle. Historically the program supported longer postdoc durations, but under the new structure the postdoctoral support period is up to two years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support package — salary, research funding, and professional development
rubrics_metrics.description: Support Includes: Salary, research funding, and professional development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowship provides financial support covering salary and research costs as well as tailored professional development opportunities to help build thriving research environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration of support and faculty follow-on award
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the new structure, Hanna Gray Fellows will receive up to two years of postdoctoral support, and up to ten years of faculty support as Freeman Hrabowski Scholars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program now pairs short-term postdoctoral support with substantial, multi-year faculty support after fellows establish independent labs (details and conditions available via the Freeman Hrabowski Scholars Program). Note historical program durations (previously up to four years postdoc + up to four years faculty) have changed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program frequency and application timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Competition Frequency: Biannual, next competition opens November 3, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan for a biannual competition cycle and sign up for program emails/announcements to receive competition timelines and application details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to building inclusive and effective research environments
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows are expected to build creative and effective research environments and foster inclusive scientific cultures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program offers tailored training and professional development to help fellows create thriving, inclusive labs; applicants should present plans and/or evidence for how they will cultivate inclusive research teams and environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement with HHMI community and networking
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows join an active network of more than 100 current program participants and the broader HHMI scientific community, connecting through collaborations and HHMI Science Meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors candidates likely to engage with the community, exchange ideas, and contribute to peer networks; applicants should indicate willingness to participate in community activities and professional development opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific focus / fit
rubrics_metrics.description: The program references 'Science We Support' as a resource describing disciplines and research areas the program funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the 'Science We Support' guidance to ensure their proposed research aligns with the program's scientific priorities and framing; fit with HHMI-supported science is an implicit consideration.
